name: Croakers & sea catfish
description: Croakers and sea catfish - the muddy channel's drumming, whiskered mid-water predators. Functional group pooling the source's 'Otolithes +' compartment (the four Pseudotolithus croakers plus the leerfish Lichia amia) with its 'Mâchoirons marins' compartment (three Arius sea catfishes): both are mid-trophic generalist predators whose diets are built on shrimps and crabs, measured as separate compartments by the source and pooled here to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
